cues.text: Let us work through Worked Pre Q2.
The key idea is that a platform model facilitates interactions between external producers and consumers.
That is the correct answer, option C.
Consider why the other statements fail.
Centralising a data centre is infrastructure management.
It concerns how computing resources are organised and run, so it is not a platform business model.
A platform business model is defined by enabling exchanges between outside producers and consumers, and moving servers into one location does not do that.
Likewise, removing governance is the opposite of responsible ecosystem operation.
A platform that runs responsibly needs rules and oversight for the participants who use it, so taking governance away would work against that goal.
So the answer is C: a platform model facilitates interactions between external producers and consumers.
